item.summary: fix(mantis): enforce verdict-expectation coherence and publish agent analysis files (#128124) * fix(mantis): enforce verdict-expectation coherence and publish agent analysis files Mantis run 32619081130 on #127989 published an overall `pass` while its own manifest recorded that the candidate expectation was not observed: per-lane `status` was mechanical capture success and the agent's judgment lived only in `expected` prose, so nothing reconciled the two before publication. - `mantis-evidence.json` schemaVersion 2: each comparison lane carries a required boolean `expectationMet`. The desktop agent sets it in the same manifest edit as `expected`; mechanical producers (Telegram live, web UI, Slack, Discord) derive it from lane status. - `scripts/mantis/publish-pr-evidence.mjs` is the single enforcement owner: it requires the booleans, recomputes `pass`/`outcome`, downgrades a contradictory pass claim to `fail`, and renders a visible "verdict downgraded" note. The desktop workflow invokes it with `--validate-only` before upload or comment. - Agent top-level `*.json`/`*.md` analysis files (assertions, comparisons, recipe suggestion) now survive the quarantine rebuild and upload, so cit
